additional_info.subject: 0445258 - ID0445258-DC/Si-D/DK[DViUun] - RTD Automation Temperature error CRM:00315002933
additional_info.body:
Hello Rasmus, good morning.
Please check the BT3 if it's indeed measuring these values:
Remove the resistance and measure it directly, and then to the KF6. If the sensor is reading those values even though it's not heat enough, please replace the BT3.
Otherwise let's check if the cables are loose.
If both of these don't work, please check the backside of the KF6 and see if there are any sort of bended/damaged pins.
I recommend brining a spare BT3 and KF6 (just in case).
I will send this ticket back to you for troubleshooting. Please let me know if you need remote support on this.
Thanks!
BEst regards,
Francisco
